Entre 3 y 6 años de experiencia en administración de tecnologías de backup y/o almacenamiento empresarial. Experiencia con al menos una solución de backup empresarial como Dell NetWorker, Avamar, PowerProtect Data Manager (PPDM), Veeam, Commvault o tecnologías equivalentes. Experiencia trabajando con plataformas de almacenamiento de fabricantes como Dell, HPE, NetApp, Hitachi o similares. Conocimientos de administración de sistemas, monitorización, gestión de capacidad y resolución de incidencias. Experiencia trabajando en entornos empresariales con elevados requisitos de disponibilidad. Capacidad para documentar procedimientos, configuraciones e incidencias de forma clara y estructurada. Nivel de inglés B2 o superior para participar en reuniones con clientes y equipos internacionales. Perfil analítico, resolutivo y orientado a la mejora continua. Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y comunicarse eficazmente con diferentes interlocutores. The Ricoh Promise define tu experiencia a través de cuatro pilares que dan forma a nuestra cultura. Love to Connect Formarás parte de una comunidad global basada en la apertura, la inclusión y la colaboración genuina. A través de equipos, países y funciones, encontrarás personas que escuchan, se implican y se apoyan, ayudándote a sentirte valorado y a ser tú mismo cada día. Love to Grow Tu desarrollo es realmente importante para nosotros. Apoyamos tu crecimiento profesional poniendo a tu alcance herramientas y recursos que te ayuden a desarrollar tus habilidades y a mantenerte preparado para el futuro en un entorno en constante cambio. Love to Give Back El propósito forma parte de nuestra manera de trabajar. Tendrás oportunidades para marcar la diferencia a través de iniciativas de voluntariado, sostenibilidad y programas comunitarios que reflejan nuestros valores y nuestro compromiso con un impacto positivo. Love to Succeed En Ricoh, el éxito se construye en equipo. Trabajarás en un entorno flexible, con recursos que cuidan el bienestar y un reconocimiento real al trabajo bien hecho, a través de iniciativas como los Imagine. Change. Awards. Creemos que la diversidad de perspectivas nos hace más fuertes. Por eso, nuestras decisiones de selección se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, y trabajamos con un firme compromiso por un proceso justo e inclusivo.

Wie ben jij? Wij zoeken een technisch systeembeheerder die zich verder wil ontwikkelen op het gebied van netwerken én systeembeheer. Je bent leergierig, praktisch ingesteld en houdt ervan om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken. Daarnaast: Heb je een HBO werk- en denkniveau richting (Bedrijfskundige) Informatica of vergelijkbaar; Beschik je over minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring; In het bezit van een rijbewijs; Heb je kennis van Windows-systemen (must), Linux (pré), netwerken, cloudoplossingen (IaaS), firewalls, routers en switches; Kun je goed plannen en organiseren, met ervaring in projectmanagement; Spreek je vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris tussen €3.700 - €4.900 per maand (afhankelijk van ervaring); 30 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband; Laptop, mobiele telefoon en ruime opleidingsmogelijkheden via onze TABS Academy; Flexibele werkmogelijkheden: grotendeels op kantoor in Utrecht, maar flexibel indien nodig; Een uitdagende rol in een dynamische organisatie waar geen dag hetzelfde is; Korting op al onze producten – handig als je zelf klust! Over TABS Holland TABS Holland is dé toonaangevende leverancier van hout en bouwmaterialen in Nederland. Met vestigingen door het hele land zijn wij altijd dichtbij onze klanten. Onze IT-afdeling speelt een cruciale rol in het ondersteunen van onze groeiende organisatie. We bieden een werkomgeving waarin innovatie, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Solliciteren? Zie jij jezelf al aan de slag gaan als systeembeheerder bij TABS Holland? Stuur dan jouw CV en motivatiebrief naar via de solliciteren knop. Voor vragen kun je contact opnemen met Mike Simons via 06-57733070 of Mike.Simons@tabsholland.nl. We kijken uit naar jouw sollicitatie!

Represent Implementation team to the customer throughout sales process including written and oral communications. Customer Success Management: Define and implement the Customer Success Management framework, segmentation, engagement model, governance and lifecycle standards for enterprise customers. Ensure structured onboarding, adoption planning and transition from solution delivery into steady-state customer success. Drive proactive customer health management, service reviews, adoption, value realization and risk mitigation for assigned customer segments. Coordinate cross-functional resolution of customer issues and ensure clear ownership, visibility and closure of critical actions. Develop customer success plans that connect contracted outcomes, solution adoption and measurable business value. Identify and coordinate expansion, renewal and advocacy opportunities with Sales while maintaining clear role accountability. Capture customer insights and recurring service themes to improve solutions, delivery standards, product roadmaps and operating processes Education : Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Management, Sales, Marketing or a related discipline Master’s degree in engineering, Business Management, Sales, Marketing or equivalent preferable Fluent in both French/English Experience: Minimum 8 years' experience including: 3 years' leadership within TELCO, Bank, Fintech, FMCG Experience in Public Sector, Corporate, SME market as well as Project Management are an asset Manager track record of 5 years or more At least 5 years in overall project implementation for large telecommunications or ICT projects Demonstrated experience in solution engineering, sales enablement, customer success, or ICT solutions deployment

review_candidates.title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer with C#/.NET Experience
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Our client is a world-leading reinsurance and risk management company, delivering comprehensive solutions across insurance, underwriting, and data-driven risk assessment. With a strong focus on innovation and long-term stability, they support clients in addressing complex risks and driving sustainable value in an ever-changing global landscape. We are looking for an Azure DevOps Engineer with C#/.NET experience to strengthen our development and platform delivery setup. The ideal candidate has a strong background in Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and automated deployment processes. The role focuses primarily on building and maintaining reliable deployment pipelines, supporting Azure-based environments, and ensuring scalable, secure, and maintainable release processes. What You'll Be Doing Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. Build and operate automated deployment and release processes for Azure-based solutions. Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM Templates. Support automated environment provisioning, configuration, and deployment strategies. Maintain and improve Azure platform delivery standards, deployment governance, and operational best practices. Collaborate with developers, architects, and other technical teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and maintainable delivery processes. Support backend integration scenarios involving Azure Functions, APIs, and C#/.NET components. Troubleshoot deployment issues, pipeline failures, environment inconsistencies, and integration-related problems. Contribute to the improvement of release quality through testing, monitoring, documentation, and engineering best practices. Support the continuous improvement of DevOps processes, automation, and platform reliability. What You'll Bring Along Bachelor’s degree in Informatics or similar field of study/or equivalent working experience is required Minimum 5 years demonstrable experience in a DevOps Engineer role Hands-on experience as an Azure DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, or similar role. Strong practical knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and Azure-based delivery processes. Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably using Terraform; knowledge of Bicep or ARM Templates is also beneficial. Good understanding of Azure services, environment provisioning, cloud platform operations, and deployment governance. Experience with automated deployment strategies, release management, and environment configuration. Practical experience or solid understanding of backend development using C#/.NET. Experience with Azure Functions and serverless architectures. Good understanding of API development, integration patterns, and backend service connectivity. Ability to read, understand, and support backend code and integration components. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, especially in relation to deployment, infrastructure, pipeline, and environment issues. Good collaboration and communication skills when working with developers, architects, stakeholders, and other technical teams. Excellent command of both spoken and written English. Experience with Power Platform integration scenarios, such as Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, or custom connectors is nice to have
